description.zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符。
description.en: The application ID. This ID is generated when you create the application in the console. It contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length.
The user ID of the user whose comment ban is to be canceled.

description.zh: 房间的唯一标识，在调用CreateRoom时返回。
description.en: The unique identifier of the room, returned when you call the CreateRoom operation.

description.zh: 操作人的用户ID，用于表示谁执行了取消禁言的操作。
description.en: The user ID of the operator, which indicates who performed the cancel comment ban operation.
